title: Droned
description:
Droned is a small project by a single dev to revive some old school action. Compete in AI league, take on the trials or battle it out in arena with your friends. 

The game reward progression by collecting new drones, weapons & utilities that compliments your play style.

AI LEAGUEBuild your ultimate drone team and take on AI-controlled squads based on real player loadouts. Climb the leaderboard and defend your rank in this solo competitive mode.

TRIALSA high intense co-op mode—a gauntlet of brutal combat scenarios designed to push your tactical mastery to the edge. Bring your best drone, a trusted ally, and a high-level Codex if you hope to survive. Do you have what it takes to conquer them all?

ARENACompete in intense Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes against real players or bots in fast-paced, high-stakes combat. Victory goes to the last drone standing—or the team with the sharpest tactics and deadliest aim.

 

CUSTOMIZATION AND LOADOUTCustomize your drones with a growing collection of weapons & utilities.
